(449)༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i lha mcha

tei:div.tei:p: /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i mgon// kun dga'i dam chos snying po'i don ston pa// gang de'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i tshogs rnams la// mchog tu dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dpag yas tshogs gnyis yun ring goms pa'i mthus// bod yul dbus kyi sa yi thig le mchog /chos bzang lha yi mdun sa dang mtshungs par// skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje'i mtshan// skad gnyis smra ba'i rigs su nyer bltams pa// kun bzang grub pa'i dbang pos lung bstan bzhin// rnam 'dren mchog tu 'khrungs la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'du ba rnam bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nyer 'tshe yis// rnam par gces pa'i tshe na grub pa'i mgon// 'bar ba'i mgon po dngos su byon nas kyang*// phyi nang bar chad bsal la mgos= /de tshe rlung sems dhū tir tshud pa yis// rgyal ba sras bcas dpag yas mkha' la gzigs// rdo rje theg pa'i bag chags yongs sad nas// dang ba stobs su gyur la= /gzhan gyis ma bstan yongs su ma bskul bar// 'gro ba kun la snying rje'i 'jug ba rgyas// theg mchog lha dang rig sngags dam chos tshul// ngang gis yongs su mkhyen la= /yi ge'i phyi mo la sogs rang mkhyen cing*// skyes rabs gleng bzhi la sogs gtam mang rnams// 'bad rtsol med par thos pa tsam gyis chub// 'khor mang dga' ba skyed la= /dgyes pa'i rdo rje rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mi g.yo sgrol ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs kyi// sgrub thabs du ma lo bdun lon tshe gsungs// blo gsal (450)kun gyi gtso bor mgos= /mkhas mchog byams pa'i gsung ngag nyer bsten te// sde snod gsum dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang*// sgra tshad rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la sbyangs// mtshungs med smra ba'i seng ger=

/kun dga'i mtshan can bla ma chos rje yi// zhabs pad nyer bsten sdom gsum rim pas nos// dpag yas rgyud sde'i dbang lung man ngag gis// thugs rgyud yongs su gang la= /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin cing*// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i rdzogs rim nyams len gnad// rtse gcig bsgrub la nyin mtshan lhur mdzad pas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam ston= /mdo rgyud dgongs pa ji bzhin legs mkhyen nas// 'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa'i tshul lugs la// srid gsum 'di na 'gran pa'i zla bral ba// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la= /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing*// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod kun gyi// mkhas grub bye ba'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du// ma 'dres thugs su chud la= /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon brnyes pas// rmi lam mtshan ma'i tshul du bar chad bgegs// rnam par btul nas stong nyid zab mo'i don// mngon du gyur pa gang der= /'phags yul mkhas grub zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud// sangs rgyas sbas pa'i zhabs sogs bla ma las// legs par gsan nas thun mong ma yin pa'i// zab don rgya mtsho'i bdag por= /dpag med skyes rabs phreng bar mngon 'brel ba'i// gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje slob dpon mchog /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres la= /gang las mthar thug de nyid nod pa'i tshe// gnas lugs gdod ma rang bzhin lhan cig skyes// chos kun ngo bo chos sku mngon gyur te// srid zhi'i mgon por gyur la= /zab cing rgya (451)che dpag yas dam chos ston// mtha' dag gcig gyur don gyi brgyud pa brnyes// rdzogs rim zab mo'i ye shes mngon gyur pa// bde chen dang po'i rgyal bar= /'phags yul shing rta chen po bcu drug dang*// grub thob 'khor los sgyur ba bgrang yas kyi// bka' babs byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan thob// chos kyi rgyal po bla mar=

/rdo rje theg pa'i 'phags lam rjes mthun nas// bcu gnyis rdo rje'i gnas pa mngon gyur te// rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /gdung 'tshob gyur pa gang der= /skye ba kun tu rjes bzung yi dam lha// 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson tshe// bdag nyid he ru kar gyur mtshan ma gzigs// ya mtshan dpag yas mnga' la= /sgrol ma'i dbang bzhi nod tshe rang gi lus// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs sbyangs byin brlabs te// mtha' dag rgyud kyi glegs bam rnam par gyur// gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag por= /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mngon gzigs shing*// 'phags pa lha yis the tshom drwa ba bsal// zhi ba lhas kyang 'dus pa'i rgyud don bstan// chos rgyun ting 'dzin brnyes la= /yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor mnyam bzhag pas// thog mar dge ba'i rtags rnams mthar phyin zhing*// srog 'dzin rtags snang du ma mngon gyur pa// bcos min ye shes gzigs la= /dpal ldan gsang 'dus don la mnyam bzhag pas// 'jam dbyangs thugs rjes chos kun de nyid gzigs// khro rgyal gshin rje gshed pos byin brlabs pas// mthu stobs dbang phyug gyur la= /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i don la mnyam gzhag tshe// rang lus lha sku'i gsal snang cher brtan zhing*// gnas gsum pho nya'i 'du ba legs thob pa// lhan skyes bde chen thob la= /rnam dag thugs mnga' (452)khyod kyi mnal lam du// mda' bsnun shā ba ri dang lū yi pa// dril bu 'bar 'dzin zhi ba sbas pa sogs// grub mchog du mas zhal bstan= /de dag rnams la the tshom gcod mdzad cing*// rgyud sde'i dgongs don rnam par 'grel ba'i tshe// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag yas brda thabs kyis// zab don ngo sprod brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal// dga' ldan gnas nas shākya'i mtshan ldan pas// zhal bstan mi pham mgon pos bdag nyid la// dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob// chos 'byor rgyun mi 'chad la=

/pad+ma 'byung gnas zla 'od gzhon nu dang*// brton pa bzhi ldan la sogs mchog rnams dang*// dam pa chos kyi bka' mchid yongs thob pa// bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung mgos phyag 'tshal// thos bsam mthar phyin rtse gcig sgrub la dgyes// sa steng chos kyi 'khor los khyab mdzad pa// ya mtshan mtshungs med bla ma rin chen la// mchog tu gus pa'i yid kyis mgos phyag 'tshal/ /ces pa 'di yan chad slob ma'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/// maṅga lam/// / (453) /rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gsol 'debs kha skong dad pa'i me tog ces bya ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur rgyal ba'i sras// srid zhi kun spangs srid zhi kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa bla ma'i tshul// sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sngon tshe rgyal po'i pho brang mnyan ldan tu// gyad kyi gtso bor stobs mtha' yas par gyur// rnam gzigs drung du byang chub thugs bskyed nas// nges pa'i ya mtshan thob la mgos phyag 'tshal// de nas sangs rgyas kun dang rtag tu 'grogs// byang chub spyod pa khyad par can rnams bstan// rnam 'phrul dpag tu med pas gdul bya'i khams// yongs su smin par mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal// shāka thub spyan sngar byang sems lnga brgya'i dbus// blo gros shin tu rnam par dag par gyur// nges don snying po'i bstan pa phyogs med du// 'dzin pa'i go cha bzhes la= /grub pa rig 'dzin drang srong paṇ+ḍi ta// rgyal blon bram ze khyim bdag tha mal pa// sna tshogs gzugs kyis sangs rgyas bstan skyong zhing*// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs la= /shar phyogs mya ngan bral bar de bzhin gshegs// tsam+bha ka drung 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal// ri bo'i rtse sogs sku yi bkod pa brgyad// gcig char ston par mdzad la= /de bzhin 'jig rten gzhan dang bod yul 'dir// sprul mang dus gcig ston las 'dren pa'i gtso// o rgyan dpa' bo bi ṣā rā dza nyid// sprul gzhi'i tshul du ston la=

/he ru ka yis gsang ba'i mdzod gtad cing*// thub pas chos kun bdag por rjes su gnang*// nye sras brgyad kyis mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i// 'byung gnas byin gyis brlabs la= /spyan ras gzigs kyis 'gro 'dul sems dpar bsngags/ nam mkha'i snying pos lhag pa'i bslab pa byin// rje btsun sgrol mas rtag tu zhal ston cing*// lung (454)bstan ye shes spor la= /pad+mā ka ras khrag 'thung dal du bcug /mtsho rgyal ma yis zab mo'i brda dbang bskur// ḍom+bi he rus gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma'i// bdag por mnga' gsol mdzad la= /tsān+d+ra go mīs ting 'dzin ngo sprad mdzad// bsnyun gyi zug rngu 'phags pas dngos su bkrus// dbyangs can lha mos ngag gi dbang phyug stsal// bsam yas ye shes yangs par mgos= /grub chen brgyad cu lo tsā rnal 'byor tshogs// gsol ba btab res dngos su chos gsungs shing*// a bha ya yis rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi// dkyil 'khor chen por bcug la= /gsang ba ye shes gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur// ḍā kis sman mchog rnam rgyal dngos su stsal// de bī ko ṭir mkha' 'gros bka' mchid kyis// chos drug thang mar brdal la= /lū yi pā des bde chen ngo sprod mdzad// 'khor lo gsum du tshogs kyi 'du ba rol// chags chen lam las mthong thos dran reg kun// rnam grol lung bstan thob la= /o ḍī ya na zangs mdog dpal gyi ri// sham+bha la ru rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyis bgrod// in+d+ra bo dhi pad 'byung rigs ldan che'i// zhal lung bdud rtsi gsol la= /rdo rje phag mo dus 'khor gsang 'dus kyis// 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur rgyud sde'i don// rnam par 'grel la legs so'i dbugs dbyung stsal// gsang bdag rdo rje chos la= /'jam dpal dmar nag rdo rje 'jig byed kyis// dbang bskur bdud sde 'joms pa'i lung bstan thob// bla ma grub chen brgyad kyis byin brlabs pas// chos kyi gting sleb gyur la=

/ye shes pheb pas snang grags rtog tshogs kun// dag pa'i snang bar rgya 'byams rdo rje'i glus// las can 'khor tshogs rtogs grol dus mnyam gyi// ye shes sad par mdzad la= /dbang bskur sgrub mchod chos 'khor bskor la sogs// mdzad chen ston tshe 'ja' 'od me tog char// mkha' 'gro'i brda glu (455)dri bzang ngad pas khyab// sprul bsgyur cho 'phrul ston la= /ring lugs nyams pa gsos shing 'khrul pa bsal// sngon med shing rta gsar du drangs la sogs// nges don snying po rdo rje theg mchog gi*/ bstan pa rmangs nas gsos la= /kun mkhyen chos rjes bde ba can zhing bstan// phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid phog /bu ston chen pos chos kyi cod pan bcings// thub bstan mnga' bdag gyur la= /bla ma rnams dang ris med mkhas grub tshogs// grub mthar dgyes pa'i legs so'i shis brjod ldir// skye ba gsum nas mngon par 'tshang rgya zhes// seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags la= /sangs rgyas zhal mthong mthu chen chos skyong rnams// 'bangs su mchi zhing srog gi snying po phul// mā kā la lcam dral sde 'khor bcas// ci bcol bka' bzhin sgrub la= /tshe 'dir lta ba'i sgo nas bya ba mdzad// phyi mar mdo sgyu sems sogs 'gro lding du// dngos su spel nas pad+ma thod phreng gi /phrin las 'khor los sgyur la= /phag mo sgrol ma spyod 'chang pad+ma bdes// bskul zhing dpa' bo ḍā kis glu gar gdugs// ḍā dril bde skyong bdud rtsis yongs mchod de// zhing khams mtha' yas gshegs la= /bdud kyi gnas g.yo 'jig rten rab 'byams su// ngo mtshar ltas sogs ting 'dzin sa brnyes shing*// rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa'i dge mtshan gyis// kun tu khyab par mdzad la= /au ḍī ya nar bīr+ya rā dza dang*// 'gro lding gnas su bde ba'i mgon po'i tshul// bai ḍūr+ya snang bde ba can zhing du// sa bcu'i dbang phyug ston la=

/ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i drwa bar sdom// thun mong snang ngor 'jig rten 'od ldan tu// bde gshegs nam mkha'i thig ler 'tshang rgya sogs// rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'phags pa'i yul du 'jigs 'byung sbas pa bzhin// khyod 'dra'i (456)gang zag phyis nas ma byon pa'i// drug pa'i rgyal tshab nyid du nges pa rnyed// bla med he ru ka dpal bla ma rjer// gus pa'i phyag 'tshal ngo mtshar mchod sprin 'bul// nyes byas kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag tu bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge kun khyod kyi go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// kun dga' snying po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan// rnam mthar phrin las ci 'drar bdag gyur te// phyogs las rnam rgyal gsung rab phyogs bcur spel// 'gro kun mkha' 'gro drwa bar sdom byed shog /'di phyi bar do rmi lam dag tu yang*// tā ra nā tha nyid dang mi 'bral bar// gsang ba'i mdzod thob brtul zhugs phyogs med grub// kha sbyor bde chen rol par 'tshang rgya shog /rtag tu rje btsun mnyes pa'i bya ba sgrub// byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs nas rje nyid dang*// rnam dbyer med pa'i phrin las rab 'byams kyis// mkha' khyab dzam gling bkra shis dpal 'bar shog /ces rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i ljon shing gi kha skong dam pa snga mas mdzad pa 'ga' zhig rgyas bsdus ma 'tshams pa dang lung rgyun ma bzhugs pas// rang gzhan dad pa'i gsos 'debs kyi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
